_meta.description: Captions for the 3D station fly-around. The model is an original stylized illustration of a typical Line 12 elevated station, not an official design. Each caption is a fact with its own grade.

captions.title: Two levels on one row of piers
captions.text: The concourse hangs from cantilever arms on the viaduct's own columns. The platforms and trains sit above it.

captions.title: Over the middle of the road
captions.text: From Kalyan to Sonarpada the line runs above the median of Kalyan-Shilphata Road, so the stations straddle the traffic.

captions.title: 21 to 23 metres up
captions.text: Stations on the line stand 21 to 23 m high.

captions.title: About 145 metres long
captions.text: Station drawings for Dombivli shared on X show a building about 145 m long with four street entries. Not yet confirmed by an official source.
